title: The Deserters
text: Soldiers who deserted another House's expedition huddle in a ditch, their colours torn off, their faces gaunt. They know where your Lost are held. They saw it. They want passage home in return, and they keep glancing at the dark behind them.

options.label: Take them along, and their secret, and see them safely home.

outcomes.text: They lead the way, jumping at every shadow, but they lead it true.

options.label: Hand them back to their own House, as the Pact demands.

outcomes.text: Their House is grateful. The deserters are not, and say nothing more; you are on your own.

options.label: The shrewdest gets the location out of them, and leaves them in the ditch.

outcomes.text: You learn enough to go on. Their curses follow at your backs.
